title: Obodo Nọ n'ụsọ Osimiri Ikpe
intro: Ị na-ahụ onwe gị n'obodo nta dị n'ụsọ oké osimiri, ebe ụda ebili mmiri na-agwakọta na ụda olu nke ndị mmadụ echefuru echefu. E nyere ha iwu izu ike, mana anyaukwu ha dugara na ntaramahụhụ nke a ka na-ekwu maka ya n'olu dara ụda. Ị̀ nwere ike ịchọpụta onye ha bụ?
clues: Anyị bi n'akụkụ osimiri, e wee nye anyị iwu ka anyị debe otu ụbọchị izu ike.
N'ụbọchị ahụ, azụ̀ ga-abịara anyị n'ụba, mana a machibidoro anyị iburu ha.
Ụfọdụ n'ime anyị dọrọ aka ná ntị megide mmebi iwu, mana ndị ọzọ gbara izu ịkụ azụ̀.
Anyị mebiri iwu dị nsọ ma wetara onwe anyị ntaramahụhụ siri ike.
Ntaramahụhụ anyị bụ mgbanwe nke mere ka anyị nwee nsogbu na ihere.
A gbanwere anyị ka anyị bụrụ enwe, ihe ịrịba ama nye ndị niile ga-esochi.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
